quote: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: After complying with the requirement to stop, a person driving a motorcycle, moped or trimobile or riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter may proceed straight through or turn right or left if: (1) The person waits for two complete cycles of the lights or lighted arrows of the applicable official traffic-control device and the signal does not change because of a malfunction or because the signal failed to detect the presence of the motorcycle, moped, trimobile, bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter; (2) No other device at the place prohibits either or both such turns, if applicable; and (3) The person yields the right-of-way to pedestrians and other traffic proceeding as directed by the signal at the intersection.

activation.condition: steady red after a motorcycle stop

obligation.description: Wait for two complete cycles before the permitted right turn, with no prohibiting device and yield to directed traffic and pedestrians.

timing.description: after complete cycles and before entering the right turn

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: signal failed to detect the presence
judgment_calls_needed.note: Physical malfunction or nonresponse cause requires original signal and detector evidence.
